title: 1 Kings 18:1 — Elijah: word of the LORD came in the third year (circled)
summary: The text of 1 Kings 18:1 again, now with the line 'that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying,' circled with a green oval. The names LORD and Elijah are lettered in colours.

text.text: 1 Now it happened after many days that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, “Go, show yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain on the face of the earth.”

numbers.note: the third year of the drought

keywords: rain on the face of the earth
